description: SFLOW explicit (A 210 2, A 220 3, A 209 0): two basins 4 m deep joined by a gap one cell wide (4 m) in a wall of dry land (T 10, 2 m above the water), the water of the west basin 0.5 m higher. The cells of the gap have dry cells on both sides in y and stay wet, the water runs through (gauges in the gap at x = 58 and 62 m and behind it). 'avoid isolated wet cells' of sflow_eta::wetdry dried such cells before: no water passed.
covers: sflow_eta::wetdry: a wet cell is dried when it is closed in x and in y
